payload.title: Build the sexuality and gender-identity cues on all seven tasks and answer with Laya
payload.description: Design A from docs/sexuality-gender-identity-preregistration.md: the sexuality spouse-clause cue and the gender-identity clause, both gender-matched to the bio's pronoun, inserted on all seven Bias in Bios tasks with the batch-1 eligibility and insertion rule. Run Laya (free) on every task and version, score same-sex vs opposite-sex and each version vs the floor, and report every cell including cells where the interval includes zero.
